verdict.rationale: iTerm2 has documented native tmux integration/control mode (tmux -CC) that creates native iTerm2 windows/tabs/panes from a tmux session, persists across disconnects/ssh loss, and supports reattaching with full state restoration, all clearly documented on the official docs site. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration specifically of tmux -CC usage (community evidence covers other iTerm2 features but not tmux control mode directly).
